freeze_rule: Commit before first time-segment polynomial evaluation, fixture generation or numerical comparison. Metadata and source inspection preceded freeze. Retain failures; no fitted offsets, threshold tuning or silent reference replacement.
scope: Acquire an integrated geocentric time ephemeris independent of ERFA/FB90, reproduce its interpolation through two readers, and map TT to its TDB argument. Research only; not full observer-arrival qualification.

kernel.redistribution: Original binary and raw coefficient excerpts are not vendored. Publicly retain official acquisition URL, checksum and our derived research results; no blanket redistribution permission is claimed.

reader_contract.primary: CSPICE spksfs/spkpvn raw Type 2 evaluation; no unitim, str2et, LSK approximation, aberration, light time or candidate imports
reader_contract.crosscheck: jplephem SPK Type 2 compute_and_differentiate on two-part JD; derivative divided by 86400
reader_contract.shared: Both readers consume the same DE440t coefficients. Reader agreement is implementation evidence, not two independent physical realizations.
reader_contract.input: TT seconds from J2000 noon; preserve a separate small delta=TDB-TT. Gregorian 2024 UTC dates use independently constructed TT=UTC+37+32.184 seconds, never candidate TT output.
reader_contract.equation: delta + D(TT + delta) = 0 where D(b)=TT-TDB at TDB coordinate b
reader_contract.engineering_only: Tolerances check interpolation, solver algebra and serialization, not model accuracy. CSPICE uses double ET; archive its actual argument and quantization. A picosecond correction check does not imply picosecond absolute timestamp precision.
reader_contract.normalization: Use kernel values as delivered. Preserve its IAU TDB rate/epoch convention, no fitted bias or forced zero at either probe. IAU constants are context, not an extra correction: LB=1.550519768e-8, LG=6.969290134e-10, T0=2443144.5003725 JD, TDB0=-65.5 microseconds.

sample_design.historical: All 12 unique geocentric instants from Mission 38 dates x hours; do not inflate by four sites or six targets
sample_design.diagnostics: Retain every signed Astropy geocentric minus integrated reference difference, with no physical accuracy threshold; compare historical values with Mission 41 archival evidence. Site contributions are not included in the geocentric reference.
sample_design.site_mapping: Document required geocentre-to-site terms, scaling, frame and time arguments separately. Do not add a site Einstein term to the existing Astropy site clock or silently replace the selected convention. All 48 site clocks and 288 combined arrival cases remain unqualified.

sources.role: Park et al. 2021, section 2.3: integrated time transformation, IAU normalization, site and higher-order terms
TT-TDB is first component in seconds, JD argument in ephemeris timescale
Raw segment evaluation and TDB seconds since J2000

next_gate: Establish a bounded independent site-clock mapping and reconcile its convention with the selected model before any combined arrival comparison or production eligibility.
